concept.title: The Photos buttons
concept.shortdesc: What the buttons under Photos are for on a person, an event or a source.

conbody.p: A person's page, an event and a source each have a part named . It has three round-cornered buttons in a row. Under them, the page says No attachments yet until you add a picture.
The same three buttons appear when you attach a copy of a source. says which file to send to family, and whether the pictures go with it.

section.title: The camera button
section.p: The first button has a camera on it. It is for a new photo, such as a photo of a certificate.
The first time, the asks if may use the camera. Choose to take photos in the app. If you do not allow it, a box says that the camera is needed to photograph a document.

section.title: The folder button
section.p: The second button has a folder on it. It is for a picture or a scan that is already on your . Your opens its own Files screen. Choose a picture, or choose the cross at the top to leave it. A panel for opening a file opens. Choose a picture, then , or choose to leave it.
A box named then asks for a few words about the picture, for people who cannot see it. Type them and choose . The picture shows under the buttons.
Look under the buttons. If they still say No attachments yet, the picture was not added, though no message says so. A picture that is already in the tree can be added with the chain button.
If the Files screen closes and nothing is added, choose the folder button and the picture again.
If the picture shows only as a thin strip, open the page again. The buttons under the picture, such as , can then be a long way down the page. Keep scrolling to reach them.

section.title: The chain button
section.p: The third button has a chain link on it. It is for a picture that is already in this tree, so you can use it again on a second person. A list named opens, with a box to search the pictures by what they show. A new tree has none yet. Choose to leave it. Choose a picture to add it to the page. It shows under the buttons at once.
If the app closes when you choose this button, open it again. Your tree and its pictures are kept.

section.title: The fourth button
section.p: When a page already has pictures, a fourth button shows, with an arrow that points down. It copies all the pictures of that page to a folder. Your opens its own screen for choosing a folder. To leave it without copying, choose the back arrow at the top, then the cross.
